descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior Go Developer to join our engineering team and contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of high-performance, scalable, and reliable software applications. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in Golang, backend development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems, with a focus on building efficient and maintainable solutions.
Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and services using Go (Golang).
Build scalable, high-performance, and reliable microservices and distributed systems.
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and other communication interfaces.
Design and implement efficient data processing and backend solutions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and resource utilization.
Work with relational and NoSQL databases, ensuring efficient data storage and retrieval.
Implement unit tests, integration tests, and automated testing strategies.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues and performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with software engineers, architects, DevOps teams, and other stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural and technical decisions.
Work with CI/CD pipelines and contribute to deployment and release processes.
Ensure code quality, security, reliability, and adherence to development best practices.
 Required Skills & Experience 
5+ years of professional software development experience, including strong hands-on experience with Go (Golang).
Advanced knowledge of Go programming language and its core concepts, including concurrency, goroutines, and channels.
Strong experience in backend development and building scalable applications.
Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience developing RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services.
Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and clean code principles.
Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and/or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with message brokers and event-driven architectures.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Knowledge of Docker and containerization technologies.
Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and debugging.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
Knowledge of Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging technologies.
Experience with security standards, authentication, and authorization mechanisms.
Familiarity with frontend technologies or full-stack development.
 Soft Skills 
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables.
Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Ability to mentor junior developers and share technical knowledge.
Attention to detail and commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
